m: सं-√ स्था Ā. -तिष्ठते (Pāṇ. i, 3, 22; ep. and mc. also P. -तिष्ठति; Ved. inf. -स्थातोस्, ĀpŚr.), to stand together, hold together (pf. p. du. -तस्थाने, said of heaven and earth), RV.; to come or stay near (loc.), ib.; VS.; ŚBr.; to meet (as enemies), come into conflict, RV.; to stand still, remain, stay, abide (lit. and fig.; with वाक्ये, ‘to obey’), MBh.; R. &c.; to be accomplished or completed (esp. applied to rites), Br.; ŚrS.; Mn.; MBh.; BhP.; to prosper, succeed, get on well, MBh.; to come to an end, perish, be lost, die, MBh.; Kāv.; BhP.; to become, be turned into or assume the form of (acc.), Lalit. : Caus. -स्थापयति (Subj. aor. तिष्टिपः, ŚBr.), to cause to stand up or firm, raise on their legs again (fallen horses), MBh.; to raise up, restore (dethroned kings), ib.; to confirm, encourage, comfort (आत्मानम्, or हृदयम्, ‘one's self’ i.e. ‘take heart again’), Kāv.; Pañcat.; to fix or place upon or in (loc.), Kauś.; MBh. &c.; to put or add to (उपरी), Yājñ.; to build (a town), Hariv.; to heap, store up (goods), VarBṛS.; to found, establish, fix, settle, introduce, set a foot, MBh.; R.; Rājat.; to cause to stand still, stop, restrain, suppress (breath, semen &c.), AitBr.; to accomplish, conclude, complete (esp. a rite), Br.; Kauś.; MBh.; to put to death, kill, ŚBr.; MBh.; to perform the last office for i.e. to burn, cremate (a dead body), ŚāṅkhBr.; to put to subjection, subject, MW. : Desid. of Caus. -स्थापयिषति, to wish to finish or conclude, ŚāṅkhBr.

॥ * ॥ tataSca sa sfzwinastu saMsfzwItyetadvacanaM tulyarUpasambanDisaMsargakftaviSezapratipattyarTaM tena sodarARAM sApatnAnAM BrAtfputtrARAM pitfvyARAM tulyAnAM sadBAve saMsargI gfhRIyAt vAkyAdaviSezaSruteH । pUrvvavacane sarvvezAmeva prakftatvAt sarvvezu cAkzepAsamBavAt । ato na BrAtfmAtravizayamidaM vacanamiti jImUtavAhanaH ॥ sodare tvasaMsfzwini saMsfzwinyasodare ca sati katarastAvat gfhRIyAt । evaMsodarAsodarayoH saMsfzwayoH sadBAve katara ityatra praTamata Aha anyodaryyastviti । anyodaryyaH punaH saMsfzwI san gfhRIyAt nAnyodaryyamAtraH kintu asaMsfzwyapi pUrvvavacanasTasodarapadAnuzaNgAt prAptaH sodaraSca gfhRIyAt । tena ekatra vizaye pUrvavacanoktasaMsfzwatvasodaratvayorekaSastulyatvAduBayorviBajya grahaRam । taduBayasattve ca asodaryyasyAsaMsfzwino'tulyarUpatvAtneti । dvitIye Aha saMsfzwo nAnyamAtfja iti । sodare saMsfzwini sati anyamAtfjaH saMsfzwyapi na gfhRIyAt । arTAttatra saMsfzwI sodara eva gfhRIyAt । saMsfzwatvAviSeze'pi sodaratvena tasya balavattvAt । dAyaBAgakArAstu anyodaryyastu saMsfzwI san satyapi sodare'saMsfzwini DanaM haret nAnyodaryyaH saMsfzwyapi gfhRIyAditi pUrvvArdDasyArTaH । tatra kiM sodarastadAnIM na gfhRIyAdevetyapekzAyAmuttarArdDenoktaMasaMsfzwyapi cAdadyAt sodara ityanuzajyate na saMsfzwo'nyamAtfjaH kevalaH । kintu uBAByAmeva viBajya grahItavyamityAhuH । mitAkzarAdayo'pyevam । yAjYavalkyadIpakalikAyAM SUlapARimahAmahIpADyAyastu । anyodaryyastu saMsfzwI nAnyodarTyI DanaM haret । asaMsfzwyapi sodara eva gfhRIyAt na tu saMsfzwaH sApatnyo BrAtA । saMsfzwa iti gaBasaMsfzwaH sodara iti kecit । nAnyodaryyo DanaM haret iti pAWe anyodaryyaH san DanaM na gfhRIyAt iti vyAKyA asaMsfzwasodarasyADikArArTamidaM vacanamato na punaruktirityAhuH । ratrAkarapraBftayastu kalpatarO nAnyodaryyaDanaM hare diti pAWo dfSyate sa mUlaBUtayAjYavalkyamitA kzarApArijAtahalAyuDagranTezu nAnyodaryyo DanaM harediti pAWadarSanAt tadanusAravyAKyAdarSanAcca lipikarapramAda ityAhuH । iti dAyatattvam ॥

Ś. 49; Ś. 7. 23; Mu. 2. 10. --7 Consecration, sanctification, hallowing. --8 Impression, form, mould, operation, influence; यन्नवे भाजने लग्नः संस्कारो नान्यथा भवेत् H. S. --14 A purificatory rite, a sacred rite or ceremony; संस्कारार्थं शरीरस्य Ms. 2. 66; R. 10. 78; (Manu mentions 12 such Saṃskāras; see Ms. 2. 26; some writers increase the number to sixteen). --15 Purification, purity. --16 A rite or ceremony in general. --17 Investiture with the sacred thread. --18 Obsequial ceremonies. --19 A polishing stone; Ś. 6. 5 (where संस्कार may mean ‘polishing’ also). --Comp. --पूत a. {1} purified by sacred rites. {2} purified by refinement or education. --रहित, वर्जित, --हीन a. a: संस्रवः, संस्रावः — 1 Flowing, trickling, oozing. --2 A stream. --3 The remains of a libation. --4 A kind of offering or libation.

m: सं-स्रव—भाग (˚व), mfn. one to whom the remainder of any liquid belongs, VS.
सं-˚स्रवण in गर्भ-स्˚ (q.v.)
सं-स्रष्टृ mfn. one who engages in battle or contest, RV. x, 103, 3
united or connected with or concerned in anything, a partaker (opp. to परि-द्रष्टृ, ‘a beholder’), MBh.
one who mixes together or commingles, MW.
सं-स्रष्टृ See सं-√ सृज्.
सं-√ स्रु P. -स्रवति, to flow or run together, RV.; AV.; ŚBr. : Caus. स्रावयति, to cause to run together, AV.; Kauś.
संस्त् = √ सस्, q.v.
सं-स्तार m. a bed, couch (mc. for -स्तर), MārkP.
a sacrifice, Gal.
spreading out, extension, MW.
a: संस्तारः — Spreading out, extension.

m: सं-˚स्तारक (prob.) m. a layer, bed, Śīl.
सं-स्तार—पङ्क्ति f. a partic. form of the Paṅkti metre (12 + 8 + 8 + 12 syllables), RPrāt.

s: puM, (sametya stuvanti yasmin deSe CandogA iti । sam + stu + “yajYe sami stuvaH .” 3 । 3 । 31 । iti GaY .) kratuzu dvijanmanAM stutiBUmiH । ityamaraH ॥ yajYezu stutikAriRAM brAhmaRAnAM avasTAnaBUmiH saMstAva ucyate । kratuzu yajYavizayezu dvijAnAM yA stutiBUmiH sTAnaM sa saMstAva ityanvayaH । sametya stUyate Candogaratra iti saMstAvaH GaY । iti BarataH ॥

the place occupied at a sacrifice by the Brāhmans reciting hymns and prayers, ŚBr.
simultaneous or common praise, Bhaṭṭ.
a: संस्तावः — 1 Praise, celebration. --2 Hymning in chorus. --3 The place which Brāhmaṇas repeating hymns and prayers occupy at a sacrifice.

k.v: प्रेषणं यत्समाहूय तत्र स्यात्प्रतिशासनम्. स संस्तावः क्रतुषु या स्तुतिभूमिर्द्विजन्मनाम्.।

m: सं-स्तीर्ण mfn. strewn, scattered, Kauś.; Śak.
=next, MBh.; R.

having supported or composed the mind firmly (in affliction), having taken heart or courage, ib.

a: संस्तंभ् — {c5c} {c9c} P. (caus. also) 1 To stop, restrain, control; प्रयत्नसंस्तंभितविक्रियाणां कथंचिदीशा मनसां बभूवुः Ku. 3. 34. --2 To paralyze, benumb; Ku. 3. 73. --3 To take heart or courage, cheer up, compose, collect (oneself); देवि संस्तंभयात्मानं U. 4. --4 To make firm or immovable; Bg. 3. 43. --5 To support, prop up. --6 To confirm, establish, corroborate.
संस्तंभः — 1 Support, prop. --2 Confirming strengthening, fixing. --3 Stop, stay. --4 Stupefaction, paralysis.

m: सं-स्तब्ध mfn. supported, confirmed &c., MBh.
firm, rigid, Hariv.
a: संस्तब्ध — p. p. Supported, confirmed &c.; see संस्तंभ्.

m: सं-√ स्तम्भ् P. -स्तभ्नोति, or ˚नाति, to make firm, Kauś.; to support, sustain, encourage, MBh.; R. &c.; to make rigid (said of water), MBh.; to restrain, check, stop (esp. by magical means), Kathās.; to suppress (tears or sorrow), R.; BhP.; Ā. (only Impv. स्तम्भस्व) to be firm, take heart or courage, Nir. ix, 12 (in R. [B.] iv, 1, 115 -स्तम्भ id.; cf. -स्तभ्य) : Caus. -स्तम्भयति, to confirm, strengthen (आत्मानम् आत्मना, ‘one's self by one's self’), encourage, MBh.; R. &c.; to take heart or courage, R.; to make rigid or solid (water), MBh.; Rājat.; to check, stop, arrest, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to paralyze, Nalac.; to suppress, restrain (grief or tears), R.; Kālid. &c. : Desid. of Caus. सं-स्तम्भ m. obstinacy, pertinacity, firmness in resistance, MaitrS.; TBr.; Nir.; MBh.
support, prop, W.
fixing, making firm, ib.
stop, stay, ib.
paralysis, muscular rigidity, ib.
सं-˚स्तम्भनीय mfn. (fr. prec.) to be confirmed or encouraged, R.
to be stopped, W.
सं-˚स्तम्भन mfn. (fr. Caus.) constipating, obstructive, Vāgbh.
सं-˚स्तम्भन n. an obstructive remedy, Suśr.
stopping, arresting, Cat.
सं-˚स्तम्भयितृ mfn. (fr. Caus.) one who stops or restrains, a restrainer, Ragh.
one who supports, a supporter, MW.
सं-˚स्तम्भयिषु mfn. (fr. Desid. of Caus.) wishing to stop or cause to stand still (a retreating army), MBh. (C. वि-ष्टम्भ्˚).
सं-˚स्तम्भिन् mfn. stopping, averting (danger), MBh.
सं-˚स्तम्भित mfn. (fr. Caus.) supported, propped, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
stupefied, paralyzed, ib.

a scattered mass (of flowers &c.), MBh.; R.
a covering, cover, Kāvyād.
scattering, strewing (v.l. for -स्तरण), Śak.
spreading, extension, propagation (of laws or customs), Hariv.

m: सं-˚स्तरण n. a layer (of leaves &c.), couch, R.
strewing, covering over (v.l. -स्तर), Śak.

joy (= हर्ष accord to some), ib.
a: संस्तवान — a. 1 Praising properly. --2 Eloquent. --नः 1 A singer (उद्गातृ). --2 Joy, delight.

praise, commendation (also pl.), Vīrac.
mention, KātyŚr., Sch.

a: संस्तवः — 1 Praise, eulogium; Pt. 4. 89. --2 Acquaintance, intimacy, familiarity; गुणाः प्रियत्वेऽविकृता न संस्तवः Ki. 4. 25; नवैर्गुणैः संप्रेति संस्तवस्थिरं तिरोहितं प्रेस घनागमश्रियः 4. 22; Śi. 7. 31. --3 Agreeing together, harmony.

praising, hymning, BhP.

सं-स्तव—स्थिर mfn. firm through acqu˚, MW.

a: संस्तृ-स्तॄ — {5} {c9c} U. 1 To spread, strew; प्रांतसंस्तीर्णदर्भाः Ś. 4. 7. --2 To overspread.

सं-स्तोभ m. or n. (with or without मरुताम्), ‘id.’, N. of a Sāman, ĀrṣBr.

a: संस्तु — {c2c} P. 1 To praise. --2 To extol, celebrate. --3 To praise in chorus. --4 To be acquainted with, be familiar or intimate with (chiefly in p. p. in this sense); अनेकशः संस्तुतमप्यनल्पा नवं नवं प्रीतिरहो करोति Śi. 3. 31; Ki. 3. 2; see संस्तुत.

equal to, passing for (instr. or comp.), Āpast.; Kathās.; BhP.
acquainted, familiar, intimate, Kāv.; VarBṛS.; Rājat.
a: संस्तुत — p. p. 1 Praised, eulogized. --2 Praised together. --3 Agreeing together, harmonious. --4 Intimate, familiar; Māl. 7. 2. --5 Intended, aimed at; Māl. 10.

figurative mode of expression, Āpast.

सं-सुखित mfn. perfectly delighted or gratified, Lalit.
सं-सुदे See सं-√ स्वद्.

सं-स्वार m. sounding together, ŚāṅkhŚr.

सं-˚स्वेदयु mfn., Pāṇ. vii, 4, 35, Vārtt. 1, Pat.
सं-˚स्वेदिन् mfn. perspiring, Suśr.

interwoven with (instr.), ib.
